name: plugin-path-version-split
title: Pack binaries resolve from a stale plugin-cache PATH entry, not the loaded skill's root
description: A pack skill and the pack binaries it invokes are resolved by two independent mechanisms - the loaded plugin root and a PATH entry naming a specific cached version - so a skill from one release can silently drive helpers from another. Bind them, or fail with both versions named.
creator: sdelmas
